act_name: Punjab Protection of Ownership of Immovable Property Act, 2021 (Act XXVIII of 2021)
title: Protection against illegal possession and grabbing
verbatim_text: No person shall enter upon or hold or grab any immovable property without lawful authority, title or permission of the lawful owner or lawful possessor.
source_citation: Official Gazette of Pakistan / Pakistan Code (pakistancode.gov.pk), Punjab Protection of Ownership of Immovable Property Act, 2021 (Act XXVIII of 2021)

act_name: Punjab Protection of Ownership of Immovable Property Act, 2021 (Act XXVIII of 2021)
title: Filing of complaint and inquiry by Deputy Commissioner
verbatim_text: Any lawful owner or possessor of immovable property who is dispossessed illegally or threatened with illegal dispossession may file a complaint before the Deputy Commissioner who shall conduct a summary inquiry within thirty days and order restoration of possession through police assistance.
source_citation: Official Gazette of Pakistan / Pakistan Code (pakistancode.gov.pk), Punjab Protection of Ownership of Immovable Property Act, 2021 (Act XXVIII of 2021)
